signature: SUBROUTINE ZLATDF( IJOB, N, Z, LDZ, RHS, RDSUM, RDSCAL, IPIV,

params.name: ijob
params.reference:
`IJOB = 2`: First compute an approximative null-vector e

-   of Z using ZGECON, e is normalized and solve for
-   Zx = +-e - f with the sign giving the greater value of
-   2-norm(x). About 5 times as expensive as Default.

$\mathrm{IJOB} \ne 2$: Local look ahead strategy where

-   all entries of the r.h.s. b is chosen as either +1 or
-   -1. Default.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix Z.

params.name: Z
params.reference: On entry, the LU part of the factorization of the n-by-n matrix Z computed by ZGETC2: $Z = P \, L \, U \, Q$

params.name: ldz
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Z. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1, N)$.

params.name: RHS
params.reference: On entry, `RHS` contains contributions from other subsystems. On exit, `RHS` contains the solution of the subsystem with entries according to the value of `IJOB` (see above).

params.name: rdsum
params.reference: On entry, the sum of squares of computed contributions to the Dif-estimate under computation by ZTGSYL, where the scaling factor `RDSCAL` (see below) has been factored out. On exit, the corresponding sum of squares updated with the contributions from the current sub-system. If `TRANS = 'T'` `RDSUM` is not touched. NOTE: `RDSUM` only makes sense when ZTGSY2 is called by CTGSYL.

params.name: rdscal
params.reference: On entry, scaling factor used to prevent overflow in `RDSUM`. On exit, `RDSCAL` is updated w.r.t. the current contributions in `RDSUM`. If `TRANS = 'T'`, `RDSCAL` is not touched. NOTE: `RDSCAL` only makes sense when ZTGSY2 is called by ZTGSYL.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices; for $1 \le i \le N$, row i of the matrix has been interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`.

params.name: JPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices; for $1 \le j \le N$, column j of the matrix has been interchanged with column `JPIV(j)`.
